author: Rodra0
quote:
As a standalone game, it would probably be a solid 6. But for all the hype and promises for the new GTA title compared to what it actually delivered, this score is right.
Main negatives:
- 30 fps even on the PS5 Pro, and it's not stable
- Game forces you to constantly tend to Lucia
- Lucia is annoying in general
- The new wanted system feels less fun and more like a chore
- Driving feels weird
- Glitches despite infinite delays
- No mission replays
- Multiple pointless restrictions on what you can and can't do
- Weird honor-like system meant to "encourage empathy"
- Unfunny. If I ever laughed, it was at the game, not with it.
- Physical edition comes with a code that someone else can redeem before you buy it. No disk.

I could list more, but nobody would read all of it. In general, it feels like they tried to mix RDR2 with GTA V and achieved neither, while adding many new issues.
